description: This file defines the RemotePlugin class, which implements the Rust::IPlugin interface for a plugin system. It includes method declarations for plugin lifecycle management, communication, and interaction with a socket server, as well as handling different versions of the Thunder framework. The class also manages remote process launching and message sending, and maintains references to external components like the socket server and plugin host shell.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A class implementing a plugin interface for remote communication, process management, and message handling within the WPEFramework plugin system.
